story_info.title: Toby Turtle and the Rain Puddles
story_info.subtitle: Toby helps nature during a rainy day.
story_info.moral: Taking care of nature is important.

main_character.name: Toby Turtle
main_character.appearance: Toby is a young sea turtle with a rounded teal-green shell patterned in soft swirls, gentle brown eyes, and smooth blue-green flippers. He has a calm, unhurried expression.

slides.title: A Calm Morning
slides.text: Toby Turtle was by Crystal Lake. The morning was fresh and cool. He watched small green plants grow near the water. Tiny insects buzzed gently. "Slow and steady discovers wonders!" Toby said with a soft smile. He loved watching nature awaken. Everything felt calm and full of life. He felt happy to be there.
slides.speaker_notes: Toby Turtle is happy by Crystal Lake, observing small plants and insects.

slides.title: Rain Begins to Fall
slides.text: Soon, the sky turned a dark grey. Big clouds filled the air. Drip, drop! A single raindrop fell onto Toby's shell. Then more came down. The rain grew stronger and stronger. It began to pour over Blossom Meadow and the valley. Toby quickly moved under a big leaf. He watched the rain fall.
slides.speaker_notes: The weather changes from sunny to rainy, Toby finds shelter under a leaf.

slides.title: Plants in Trouble
slides.text: The rainwater made many small rivers. These little rivers rushed past the small plants. Toby saw something important. The rushing water was washing away loose soil. It was taking the tiny plants with it. Oh dear, the little plants could get washed away! Toby knew he had to think fast.
slides.speaker_notes: Toby observes the heavy rain creating small rivers that threaten the plants.

slides.title: Toby's Clever Idea
slides.text: Toby thought for a quiet moment. He had a very good idea. He used his strong blue-green flippers. He gently pushed soft mud to make little walls. His hard, teal-green shell helped push the soil too. He made the water flow safely around the plants. Toby worked carefully and slowly. He wanted them to be safe.
slides.speaker_notes: Toby uses his flippers and shell to build mud walls to protect the plants.

slides.title: Nature is Safe!
slides.text: Soon, the heavy rain stopped. The clouds moved away. The warm sun peeked out again. Toby looked at the plants. They were all safe and sound! The small mud walls had worked perfectly. "Slow and steady discovers wonders!" Toby smiled happily. He felt very good about helping nature. He felt calm and proud.
slides.speaker_notes: The rain stops, the sun comes out, and Toby sees the plants are safe thanks to his efforts.

instagram.caption: A beautiful morning by Crystal Lake turned rainy! Toby Turtle, with his calm heart and love for nature, noticed the heavy rain was washing away the soil around little green plants. He knew he had to help! With thoughtfulness and steady effort, Toby used his flippers to build small mud walls, guiding the water away and keeping the plants safe. This story reminds us that even small actions can make a big difference in protecting our precious nature. Join Toby on his rainy-day adventure!
